meta.scope: Philippines Batch 13 (final densification) — ~12 additional high-value nodes: local government finance (NTA), geothermal/renewables detail, Philippine Development Plan, crime statistics, major ports, vital statistics, and supporting frames. Closes ordinary-purpose research.

candidates.title: National Tax Allotment (NTA, formerly IRA) local government finance statistics
candidates.description: The principal intergovernmental transfer (40% share of national internal revenue taxes) automatically released to provinces, cities, municipalities and barangays. Renamed National Tax Allotment following the Mandanas-Garcia ruling. Critical equalisation and local fiscal-capacity instrument.
candidates.notes: Core subnational fiscal equalisation node (parallel to Indonesia’s DAU/DAK).

candidates.title: Geothermal power capacity and generation statistics
candidates.description: Installed and dependable geothermal capacity and related generation figures. The Philippines remains one of the world’s leading geothermal producers; geothermal forms a distinctive indigenous renewable component of the power mix.
referenced_by: Philippine Power Statistics and energy-mix nodes

candidates.title: Renewable energy project and capacity statistics (RE Act framework)
candidates.description: Summary statistics on renewable-energy projects under the Renewable Energy Act of 2008 — hydropower, geothermal, wind, solar, biomass — covering potential and installed capacity.

candidates.title: Philippine Development Plan (PDP) and NEDA planning framework
candidates.description: The medium-term national development plan (current cycle 2023–2028) and associated progress reports. Provides the overarching policy and target frame that organises statistical monitoring across sectors.
referenced_by: Almost all major statistical and programme series
Poverty, education, health and infrastructure targets

candidates.title: Crime statistics (focus crimes and crime rate)
candidates.description: Official focus-crime counts (murder, homicide, rape, physical injury, theft, robbery, vehicle theft) and overall crime-rate trends. Used in security and governance analysis.

candidates.title: Port of Manila operational statistics
candidates.description: Operational statistics for the country’s primary international container gateway (Manila International Container Terminal, South Harbor, North Harbor). Handles the large majority of international container trade.

candidates.title: Port of Cebu operational statistics
candidates.description: Operational statistics for the principal Visayas port hub — major domestic inter-island and secondary international gateway.

candidates.title: Vital statistics (births, deaths, marriages)
candidates.description: Registered births, deaths and marriages. Provides the continuous demographic flow data that complements the census and population projections.

candidates.title: Public-Private Partnership / infrastructure investment framing
candidates.description: Policy and project framing around public-private partnerships for infrastructure (transport, energy, water, etc.). Continuously cited in investment and fiscal discussions.

candidates.title: BSP Monetary Policy Report
candidates.description: Flagship periodic monetary-policy communication document that synthesises inflation, growth, external and financial conditions. High recurring-citation value across macro analysis.
referenced_by: CPI, national accounts, BOP and reserves

candidates.title: Subic–Clark special economic / freeport zone complex
candidates.publisher: Subic Bay Metropolitan Authority / Clark Development Corporation / related
candidates.description: Major freeport and special economic zone complex in Central Luzon (former US military bases). Complements the broader PEZA system with a distinctive logistics and industrial-location profile.

candidates.title: Philippines final-densification meta-node (local fiscal–geothermal–PDP–crime–ports–vital)
candidates.publisher: Derived from DBM, DOE, NEDA, PNP, PPA and PSA sources
candidates.description: Closing meta-node binding National Tax Allotment, geothermal and renewable capacity, Philippine Development Plan, crime statistics, major ports (Manila, Cebu), vital statistics, PPP framing, BSP Monetary Policy Report and Subic–Clark freeport complex into the final ordinary-purpose densification layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier fiscal, energy, planning, security, ports and demographic series
candidates.notes: Closing integrating node for the final densification pass.
